decision: Use the one-piece removable front form only if the trial shows missing support and the contractor verifies sound repair substrate/permanent backing. Its modest drafted collar clears the captured local surfaces in the tested working pose. Do not order it as a required companion to the two plate quotes; first use the plate trial to locate actual unsupported zones.

as_cast_vs_metal: Cast hole is about 118.45 x145.20 at front; metal capsule remains116.35 x151.10. Sheet bridges about1.05 mm each side and reveals some repaired wall at top/bottom. Required factory opening footprints remain inside both. No plate dimension change is needed for this trial.
comparison: One-piece 12 mm face with drafted 2 mm collar avoids split seams, rear fasteners, undercuts and loose sacrificial pieces. Panel + two collar halves was considered; it permits inward release but introduces a joint under the repaired face and needs fasteners in narrow material. The current nominal straight withdrawal test does not require that complication. Do not use one-piece if the real dry trial cannot withdraw freely.
specific_rejected_collar: 120.35 x155.10, 2 mm wall and12 mm depth intersects about79 mm2 of captured stone/hardware projection. Enlarging the repair collar to match arbitrary outlines is not permitted. RF01 is shorter and narrower, using a bounded search rather than tile alteration.

full_face_diagnostic.scope: Complete D240 front face outside its actual opening, source Z0.05..80. Includes intended stone contact/topography; not classified as all hardware. Full face seating is NOT established by the clear collar test. Rehearse on actual sound pads; do not force flat or alter tile.
